info.title: Web radio relay API
info.description: Audio-only web radio relay: live status, server-side listener delay, timed captions and archive. Public routes are for listeners and the embeddable widget. Routes under /api/v1 are control routes and need a Bearer token (RELAY_API_TOKEN). Several streams are supported: use /api/streams/{name} (public) and /api/v1/streams/{name} (control). Routes without a name are legacy and serve the default stream.

lang.description: BCP 47 language tag, e.g. fi, sv, en.

startedAt.description: Epoch milliseconds of the spoken audio on the sender clock (NTP-synced).

next.description: Pass as ?from= on the next poll.

visibleLanguages.description: Languages viewers get (translations and composedText). Default ["fi"].

radio.description: Start the radio pull when MediaMTX reports the source ready. Default true.

videoHls.description: Stored for the video phase; no effect yet. Default false.

recordOnLive.description: Stored for the recording phase; no effect yet. Default false.

publicGraphics.description: Send graphic events to viewers. Default true.

viewerKey.description: Key for /api/v1/viewer/{viewerKey}, or null (the stream name opens the viewer). Default null.

StreamConfigPatch.description: Any subset of the StreamConfig fields.

scopes.description: Each scope is admin or stream:<name>:(publish|data|control|view), name a-z 0-9 _ - up to 32 characters.

expiresInSeconds.description: Lifetime from now. Omit for a token that never expires.

token.description: The secret. Shown only in this response.

expiresAt.description: Epoch milliseconds, or null when the token never expires.

revokedAt.description: Epoch milliseconds, or null while the token is live.

probe.description: Last ffprobe result of the stream's input, in memory: set when the source becomes ready, cleared when it drops. Null when unknown.

fps.description: Average frame rate, 3 decimals; null when unknown

url.description: The url without user and password. A key-like last path segment is shown as [REDACTED]. The stream key is never here: see hasKey.

variant.description: raw: the relay stream; cc: the captioned variant (stream-cc).

startWith.description: stream: start with the relay stream when it is ready (wired by a later task); manual: only by the start route.

hasKey.description: True when a stream key is stored (encrypted with RELAY_SECRET_KEY). The key is never returned.

state.description: live after 5 s without exit; retrying after a crash (backoff 2 s doubling to 60 s); failed when ffmpeg could not be started (no automatic retry).

stderrTail.description: Last ffmpeg stderr lines, redacted (keys and credentials removed).

kind.description: facebook needs an rtmps:// url; youtube and facebook need a key.

url.description: rtmp:// or rtmps:// url (up to 2048 characters). The key goes in key, never in the url.

key.description: Stream key, 1 to 512 printable characters without spaces. Stored encrypted; needs RELAY_SECRET_KEY on the server.

DestinationPatch.description: Only the fields given change. A changed kind, url, variant or key, or enabled set to false, stops a running egress child. key null or an empty string removes the stored key.

get.description: Returns the stored PNG, JPEG or WebP bytes. The id is the SHA-256 of the bytes plus the extension, so the response never changes and is cached for a year.

parameters.name: assetId
parameters.description: 64 lower-case hex characters, a dot and png, jpg or webp.

post.summary: Upload one image for a stream (content-addressed, deduplicated)
post.description: Stores the image in S3 (assets/<assetId>) or in ASSET_DIR and returns its id. The Content-Type must match the bytes (image/jpeg for JPEG). Requires scope stream:<name>:data or the admin token. Identical bytes are stored once: reused is true on later uploads.

put.summary: Set part of the per-stream config
put.description: Only the fields sent are changed. Unknown fields are refused (400). visibleLanguages: ["*"] (default, every language) or 1 to 10 language tags; the translations viewers get and the language shown under the original (composedText) follow it. radio: the MediaMTX ready hook starts the radio pull (RADIO_ON_READY=off still wins). publicGraphics: false keeps graphic events from viewers. videoHls and recordOnLive are stored for later phases and have no effect yet. viewerKey: null, or 8-64 characters a-z 0-9 _ -; the viewer then opens at /api/v1/viewer/{viewerKey} and the stream name no longer opens it. A viewerKey used by another stream answers 409.

get.summary: LCYT-compatible viewer stream (SSE), public
get.description: Server-Sent Events for viewer pages and the LCYT Android TV app. Public: no token, CORS Access-Control-Allow-Origin *, public rate limit. The key is the stream's viewerKey when it has one (PUT /api/v1/streams/{name}/config), else the stream name (404 once the stream has a viewerKey). Viewers get only the stream's visibleLanguages; graphic events are left out when publicGraphics is false. Events: connected { ok, stream, mode }; caption { text, composedText, translations, codes, sequence, timestamp } (timestamp is ISO without Z; a translation re-sends its caption with the same sequence and translations filled); section { id, timestamp, title, kind?, index? }; graphic { id, timestamp, kind, title?, text?, assetId?, hymnNumber?, verse?, lines? }. On connect the current section, graphic and caption are sent once. A comment line is sent every 25 s.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Viewer key: the stream's viewerKey (8-64 characters a-z 0-9 _ -), or a stream name (up to 32 characters) while the stream has no viewerKey.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: live (default): events are sent when stored. delayed: events are released at startedAt plus the stream's listener delay.

post.summary: Start recording a stream to S3
post.description: Needs stream:<name>:control (admin passes). Starts a copy-only recorder that writes 60 s segments to the local spool; an uploader moves each closed segment to S3 under recordings/<stream>/<sessionId>/. Needs S3_ENDPOINT and S3_BUCKET (503 otherwise). A running recording is returned as it is.

sessionId.description: Sortable id: UTC time to the millisecond plus 8 random hex characters.

state.description: degraded: spool over RECORDING_SPOOL_MAX_BYTES, recording goes on. stopping: uploads still retried, session.json not yet written.

uploadError.description: The last S3 failure while uploading (HTTP status and S3 code only).

401.description: Missing, unknown, revoked or expired token

409.description: The previous recording of this stream is still uploading

503.description: S3 is not configured, or the relay is shutting down

get.summary: Handoff manifest of a stopped recording for Saarnavideo
get.description: Needs stream:<name>:control (admin passes). Builds an LCYT handoff manifest v1 (the contract Saarnavideo's POST /api/imports/lcyt validates) from a stopped recording: one `clean` feed whose parts are the uploaded segments, one VTT per caption language, section events as `cue` markers, marker events as `marker` markers and `data` events as variables. Every ref is a fresh presigned GET URL valid for HANDOFF_URL_TTL_SECONDS (default 86400). The manifest carries no credentials other than those query signatures. The same manifest, with the URLs of the stop time, is stored as handoff.json beside session.json.

400.description: Invalid stream name or session id

401.description: Missing, unknown, revoked or expired token

409.description: The recording is not stopped and finalized yet, or has no segments

503.description: S3 is not configured or cannot presign

delete.summary: Stop the recording of a stream
delete.description: Needs stream:<name>:control (admin passes). Stops the recorder, uploads the remaining segments (the last one too), then writes the sidecars and session.json once. If S3 fails, the answer is state stopping and the uploads are retried in the background until session.json is written.

200.description: The session (state stopped, or stopping while uploads are retried)
